heroSubheading: Genuine STIHL equipment, expert service, and spare parts for the community
aboutHtml:
We're a local STIHL dealer in Levin, run by Bevan Bisset, Ingrid De Graaf, and Scott Newton. We stock genuine STIHL outdoor power equipment for the community. Whether you're maintaining a property, running a business, or tackling a project, we have the right gear.

We sell new machines, stock spare parts, and service the equipment we've sold you. We give honest advice too. If something breaks, we'll fix it properly. Come in and talk to us about what you need.

Locals trust us because we're straightforward and reliable. We understand Levin's needs and stand behind our work. Come visit the shop and we'll help you find what you're after.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Spare parts stock when you need them
Straight advice from people who care
